entities.name: Maks Kaśnikowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maks Kaśnikowski is a Polish professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 168, achieved on 21 October 2024 and a doubles ranking of No. 688, achieved on 8 May 2023. He is currently the No. 4 Polish player.
